title: Pre-release team score endpoint exposes points and per-level components before feedback release

original_titles.title: Live team score leak via GET /v1/team/score breaks hidden feedback (verdict oracle)

problem: GET /v1/team/score returns levels, components, points and total from the score ledger without release gating. Only released_total is null before the event is closed/finalized. The hidden feedback mode therefore leaks verdict information while submissions are still being evaluated.
impact: Participants can probe their score deltas and infer matcher decisions/answer-key matches before feedback release, defeating hidden feedback and fairness controls.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Make the server determine release state per stage/team using feedback_released or the authoritative stage policy, not only event status.
Before release, return stable metadata such as evaluation_status and max_points but set total, points, component breakdown and score-derived fields to null or omit them entirely.
Apply the same gate to every participant endpoint and teammate payload that can leak point-bearing information, including dashboard, team and leaderboard snapshots.
Add a regression test that inserts evidence, code-review and penalty ledger rows, then asserts no point-bearing field is non-null before release and exact totals appear after release.

acceptance_criteria: No pre-release participant response contains exact score amounts, matched bug identifiers or component deltas.
After release, score totals reconcile to the ledger exactly.
Tests cover all participant endpoints, not only /team/score.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
